name: Weekly Planner

listing.title: Weekly Planner - Printable Weekly Schedule, Habits and Budget
listing.description:
A printable weekly planner for scheduling and tracking routines.

Inside: a cover, a How to use page, the Weekly Schedule page, the Habit Tracker page, and the Weekly Budget page.

Print on A4 or US Letter paper, as often as you need, for personal use.
listing.buyer: adults seeking an organized weekly planning system

instructions: Print the A4 or US Letter file at 100% scale.
Organize your weekly priorities and daily commitments on the Weekly Schedule page.
Record daily habits on the Habit Tracker page and manage spending on the Weekly Budget page.
cover_image_idea: The Weekly Schedule page printed on clean paper.
